host_key: # Every E. coli host appearing in LASER, classified by ACTUAL lineage rather than by
# membership in a hardcoded literal set. `host_key` is the normalized form: uppercased,
# all whitespace removed, any "(DE3)" stripped -- so "BL21 (DE3)", "BL21(DE3)" and
# "BL21(DE3) Star" reduce to BL21 / BL21STAR. is_proxy=1 means the assigned GEM is from
# a different lineage than the strain and is standing in for a model that does not exist.
# lineage `non_strain` and `unresolved` are dropped by the builder under their own blocker.
